findings.one_line: The cited result is for bounded rewards; the Gaussian upper transfer is only asserted step-by-step, and the lower transfer invokes an unprovided interior Bernoulli hard family and its testing calculation, so the Gaussian minimax feasibility rate is not discharged from the declared dependencies.
Membership in the Hölder--margin class uses αβ≤d, but ass:nontrivial-margin-regime is not in depends_on.
The constant-gap baseline has margin mass one at u=2M, and the proof uses C0(2M)^α≥1; ass:gap-margin-compatible is absent from depends_on.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim Theorem 5.1 bound, specialized to K=2, simplifies to T^{(beta+d-alpha beta)/(2 beta+d)}; its following paragraph expressly states two-arm minimax optimality up to constants under the theorem's bounded-reward model.
